title: Lower the current selected quadratic Gaussian phase to a fixed tape table with complete owner return
body:
## Exact scoped result
A 23-tape fixed graph implements the exact selected MOVE24472 quadratic Gaussian phase over all tensor columns, preserving absolute phase and original owner. Source binding and independent cost/runtime review passed. This is not the entire MOVE. Credits #7000 and #5375.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/172f4535ce8dcff79f626410af845f757c1563be/research/literal-native-quadratic-phase
